title: Malicious code in calcultimatetest (npm)
description: The npm package 'calcultimatetest' version 1.0.0 contains malicious code that acts as a staged remote-execution dropper. Upon being required, its main.js decodes a hex-encoded shell command from package.json using a key stored in config.json and executes it after a short random delay. The decoded command fetches and runs a Windows batch payload from a bare-IP HTTP URL. Although the currently published version replaces the execution target with a benign command, the malicious execution mechanism remains present and reachable. The package also modifies its installed package.json to maintain persistence of the malicious payload mechanism. The package's legitimate functionality is minimal and serves as cover for the malicious behavior.
